name: MAHLE Metal Leve S.A.
summary: MAHLE Metal Leve S.A., an automotive parts company, manufactures and sells components for internal combustion engines and automotive filters in South America, Europe, Central and North America, Africa, and internationally. It operates through Powertrain and Charging, and Thermal and Fluid Systems segments. The company offers drive systems and power electronics for electric powertrains; piston systems, cylinder components, valve trains, air conditioning, engine cooling, air management, engine cooling, oil management; and power electronics for traction drives for passenger cars, as well as electric drive and mechatronic systems for industrial applications, agricultural and construction machine…
